title: Save your money- and I love good subscriptions
text:
So I was super excited about this box after buying some of the treats individually to see if my Cleo liked them. She loved them so I figured sweet I’ll subscribe for her then. Welp the amount of what was sent didn’t even total the $25 that I paid for the box itself.

In my pic:
The two long pkgs
-2x 5.7oz each of pig strips ($20 for 2lbs)
I was sent less than 1 lbs =$8.50

-small yak nuggets (1 lbs $20)
I was sent 1/4 lb. = $5

Some microfiber towels $3

And some weird “lick suction cup” thing for the shower but idk why my dog would want to lick it but for s&g we will call it $3

$19.50 in total and I ended up with stuff I don’t need. Not a good pkg. Totally bummed!
label: negative
